At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.

Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.

About the Team

The People Strategy & Transformation (PST) is PointClickCare's HR strategy, organizational design, and portfolio management pillar. The team includes HR Business Partners, Organizational Design & Effectiveness, People Experience, and the HR Strategy & Enablement function, with a dotted-line partnership to Internal Communications. PST is responsible for ensuring HR's work across every Center of Excellence is planned, resourced, sequenced, and tracked against business outcomes — spanning a portfolio of Pillar Initiatives, Cross-Pillar Projects, and Program Roll-Ups delivered across all four HR solution groups.

Position Summary:

The Director, People Strategy and HR Portfolio (Project) Managements is the VP, People Strategy & Transformation's strategic thought partner in building and running PointClickCare's HR Portfolio Management Office (HR PMO) — co-designing the strategy, governance model, capacity methodology, and dashboard reporting that let HR plan, resource, and track its work against business outcomes. This is a net-new function: no HR PMO currently exists at PointClickCare, and this role will design these mechanics in partnership with the VP rather than operate a system someone else has already built.

Operating with significant design authority but without direct reports or final decision rights on cross-functional trade-offs, this role earns influence through the credibility of the mechanics it builds and runs. It operates across all four HR solution groups without formal authority over any of them, serves as the VP's thought partner on HR strategy and the HR SLT prioritization process, and convenes HR initiative stakeholders and Internal Communications to coordinate how HR's work reaches the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Design and run the HR Portfolio Management Office’s core operating mechanics

  • Design and maintain the capacity management methodology, including the heat map model and the oversubscription thresholds used to flag resourcing conflicts across HR COEs
  • Own and run the Portfolio Council governance cadence end to end — intake, capacity check, tier assignment, publish, mid-quarter check, and close-out
  • Build and maintain the integrated HR initiative dashboard, ensuring data currency and accuracy across every active Pillar Initiative, Cross-Pillar Project, and Program Roll-Up
  • Example deliverable: a quarterly Portfolio Council capacity heat map showing every HR COE’s current initiative load, used to approve or defer new initiative intake

Serve as strategic thought partner to the VP, People Strategy & Transformation

  • Co-design the HR SLT prioritization process and criteria used to evaluate and sequence HR initiatives each planning cycle
  • Co-design the OKR and scorecard measurement architecture — what gets measured, how it rolls up, and the cadence it runs on
  • Co-author and stress-test the HR Strategy on a Page, contributing independent analysis before it is finalized by the VP
  • Example deliverable: a documented HR SLT prioritization framework — criteria, weighting, and process — adopted for the FY28 planning cycle

Own capacity management and project plan oversight across the full HR initiative portfolio

  • Track progress against committed business outcomes, not activity completion alone, across every active HR initiative
  • Maintain consistent project plan structure, milestone tracking, and dependency mapping in partnership with each initiative’s named Delivery Lead
  • Proactively surface cross-COE capacity collisions and resourcing conflicts before they reach Portfolio Council
  • Example deliverable: a consolidated project plan view across all active Program Roll-Ups, flagging dependency risk before it affects a committed milestone

Convene HR initiative stakeholders and Internal Communications on a recurring cadence

  • Establish and run a recurring go-to-market coordination cadence bringing together initiative Delivery Leads and Internal Communications
  • Sequence the timing and stakeholder readiness of HR initiative rollouts to the business, avoiding duplicate or conflicting messages landing in the same window
  • Maintain a shared go-to-market calendar visible to HR SLT, showing what is launching, when, and to whom
  • Example deliverable: a quarterly HR go-to-market calendar sequencing every planned initiative rollout to the business, reviewed and approved by HR SLT before the quarter begins

Represent HR in enterprise planning and governance forums

  • Serve as the primary operational liaison to the Strategic Delivery Office, aligning HR’s initiative classification and intake practices to enterprise taxonomy
  • Represent HR’s initiative portfolio and capacity picture in the Corporate Strategy Group’s quarterly planning cadence
  • Flag enterprise-level dependencies or conflicts affecting HR’s ability to deliver against committed priorities
  • Example deliverable: HR’s consolidated initiative and capacity submission into the Corporate Strategy Group’s quarterly planning sprint, reflecting current Portfolio Council status

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 10–15 years of experience in program/portfolio management, management consulting, or a PMO leadership capacity, including demonstrated experience designing — not only operating — portfolio governance, capacity management, or OKR measurement systems
  • A track record serving as a strategic thought partner to a senior leader, with evidence of shaping that leader's thinking rather than only executing direction
  • Demonstrated experience operating in matrixed, cross-functional environments without formal authority over the teams being coordinated
  • Strong data and dashboard fluency — comfortable architecting reporting tools and the metrics model behind them, not just maintaining an existing build
  • Executive-level communication skills — this role prepares materials for and interacts directly with VP-level stakeholders across every HR pillar
  • Experience convening cross-functional stakeholder groups to coordinate sequencing and alignment on complex, multi-team initiatives

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience building a PMO or governance function from scratch, in a design capacity, rather than operating within an already-mature one
  • HR domain experience, including familiarity with COE structures and business-outcome-linked workforce initiatives
  • Experience partnering with internal communications or marketing functions on coordinated, multi-stakeholder rollouts

title: Events Design Producer
description:
About the Role

We’re seeking an experienced Events Design Producer to lead the design production of high-profile events and experiences across the company.

This is a high-impact role embedded within a fast-moving, cross-functional organization. You will oversee multiple event design workstreams, providing operational structure and hands-on production leadership from early concept development through fabrication, installation, and live execution.

You’ll partner closely with creative, events, production, brand, marketing, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure every physical and visual touchpoint is cohesive, on brand, and delivered to an exceptionally high standard. You will coordinate internal teams, agencies, fabricators, and vendors while balancing resources and priorities across concurrent projects.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead design production across company events, from intimate gatherings to large-scale global experiences

  • Oversee the design development and execution of event environments, stages, signage, wayfinding, scenic elements, activations, and branded guest experiences

  • Establish clear roles, workflows, workback schedules, budgets, and quality standards across event design workstreams

  • Assess incoming event design needs and coordinate creative resources, agencies, fabricators, and vendors based on scope, timing, and complexity

  • Provide hands-on production leadership to keep complex or high-priority event design projects moving from concept through onsite delivery

  • Partner closely with event leads and creative teams to translate event goals, audience journeys, and program narratives into clear design briefs and deliverables

  • Guide designers and external partners in developing cohesive spatial, environmental, scenic, digital, and print design systems that align with brand standards

  • Synthesize and prioritize input from multiple stakeholders, turning feedback into clear, actionable direction for designers, agencies, fabricators, and vendors

  • Maintain visibility across design milestones, budgets, approvals, dependencies, fabrication schedules, installation plans, risks, and onsite production documentation

  • Ensure tight alignment across event identity, environment, stage, signage, digital surfaces, printed materials, and the end-to-end audience experience

  • Lead design reviews, technical handoffs, site walks, production check-ins, and onsite quality control through installation and live execution

  • Drive design-production decisions in a fast-paced environment with shifting directives, compressed timelines, and competing priorities

  • Identify opportunities to improve event design production processes, briefs, templates, vendor workflows, and ways of working

  • Maintain calm, clarity, and executional rigor during high-pressure moments leading up to and during event installation and live execution

  • Partner with creative and events leads to continually reprioritize projects and creative resourcing as urgent needs arise

  • Develop integrated workback schedules for multiple cross-functional teams across several concurrent global events; communicate deadlines proactively and consistently, and anticipate and address blockers as they arise

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 8+ years of experience producing event design, experiential design, environmental design, or branded experiences, ideally within technology or a fast-moving global organization

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams of designers, creative producers, agencies, fabricators, technical partners, and vendors

  • Demonstrated ability to oversee multiple complex event design and production workstreams simultaneously

  • Strong creative-production leadership skills, with the ability to provide clear direction, thoughtful feedback, and support to teams working under tight timelines

  • Experience managing creative workstreams from early concept and design development through fabrication, installation, live execution, and strike

  • Strong visual judgment and experiential storytelling instincts, with exceptional attention to detail across spatial design, brand expression, materials, and guest experience

  • Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, synthesize diverse opinions, and establish clear priorities and decision paths

  • Confidence working directly with senior leaders and guiding stakeholders through rapid creative review and approval cycles

  • Strong budget, resource-planning, vendor-management, and project-management skills, including the ability to anticipate risks and resolve competing demands

  • Composure, decisiveness, and reliability under tight deadlines, onsite installation demands, and live-event pressure

Additional Details

  • Must be in San Francisco 3 days a week to work closely with internal teams

  • Travel will be required for major company events, site visits, installations, and production weeks

  • Extended hours should be expected as key event milestones, installations, and live dates approach

Why This Role Matters

Events are among the company’s most visible and important brand moments. This role will ensure that event design projects across the company are scoped thoughtfully, managed effectively, and delivered with consistency, precision, and craft.

By connecting creative ambition with production reality, the Events Design Producer will help build a scalable, high-performing function that turns ideas into cohesive, memorable experiences for audiences around the world.

About the Role

The Senior Product Enablement Specialist serves as a subject-matter expert for the White Label Mobile App operation, handling high-complexity cases, major customer escalations, new platform challenges, and process improvements, billing and subscription related concerns.

In addition to independently managing complex apps, the Senior PES helps improve team performance through coaching, documentation, root-cause analysis, and collaboration with Product and Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced App & Escalation Management

  • Own complex and high-priority White Label Mobile App cases.

  • Handle advanced Apple and Google rejection scenarios.

  • Lead investigation of recurring submission, build, account, and platform issues.

  • Manage sensitive or escalated agency owner cases through resolution.

  • Identify root causes and determine whether issues require operational, product, or engineering solutions.

  • Coordinate directly with Product and Engineering on high-impact issues.

  • Serve as the central point of contact to align support and billing departments on related customer issues

Subject-Matter Expertise

  • Serve as an escalation point for PES I and PES II specialists.

  • Maintain advanced knowledge of Apple App Store and Google Play requirements.

  • Investigate new rejection types and establish repeatable resolutions.

  • Create and improve SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and internal documentation.

  • Help ensure processes remain current as Apple, Google, and the White Label Mobile App product evolve.

  • Leverage AI tools and platforms to streamline troubleshooting, accelerate SOP creation, and optimize internal documentation workflows.

Coaching & Team Enablement

  • Coach and mentor PES I and PES II specialists.

  • Assist specialists with complex cases and troubleshooting.

  • Share best practices and recurring learnings with the team.

  • Support onboarding and training of new specialists.

  • Help identify knowledge and process gaps across the team.

Process & Operational Improvement

  • Analyze recurring blockers, rejection trends, customer issues, and operational inefficiencies.

  • Recommend opportunities for automation and process improvements.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to reduce manual work and recurring issues.

  • Help improve operational SLAs, customer communication, tracking, and reporting.

  • Participate in pilots and testing of new White Label Mobile App processes and features.

  • Provide operational feedback based on customer and team experience.

Required Technical Skills

  • Advanced working knowledge of the Apple and Google mobile app ecosystems, including submission, review, release, transfer, and account-management processes.

  • Strong understanding of Apple Developer, App Store Connect, Google Play Console, certificates, identifiers, provisioning, API keys, APNs, and Firebase.

  • Advanced troubleshooting of build failures, submission failures, store rejections, account/configuration issues, and mobile app integrations.

  • Ability to investigate technical issues across multiple systems and determine whether the root cause is related to configuration, platform/store requirements, product behavior, customer setup, or Engineering.

  • Strong understanding of APIs, JSON/configuration files, authentication/access concepts, logs, and developer tools sufficient to support technical investigation.

  • Advanced Google Sheets/Excel skills and ability to build or improve operational trackers, reporting, data validation, and workflow automation.

  • Experience designing and improving SOPs, technical workflows, troubleshooting guides, and escalation processes.

  • Ability to identify opportunities for automation and reduction of manual operational work.

  • Ability to coach PES I and PES II team members on technical troubleshooting and complex app cases.

  • Strong knowledge of Apple and Google mobile app submission processes.

  • Experience managing complex customer escalations.

  • Ability to coach and support other team members.

  • Strong written, verbal, and cross-functional communication skills.

  • Ability to identify patterns and turn recurring problems into scalable solutions.

  • New Apple and Google issues are quickly understood, documented, and operationalized.

  • Recurring problems result in process, product, or automation improvements.

title: Director, UX Research
description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Director, UX Research (M5) who can make deep customer understanding a driving force in HighLevel's product and company strategy. You have spent 12+ years conducting and leading research for complex digital products, including 5+ years leading researchers or research programs, and are ready to set the research direction for a broad platform used by agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs around the world.

This role reports to the Vice President of Product Design and is a member of Design Leadership. You will lead a small, senior research team of one or two researchers and remain a hands-on practitioner who personally leads the company's highest-stakes studies.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate exceptional research craft, strategic judgment, cross-functional influence and executive communication. You should be comfortable framing ambiguous business questions, choosing the right level of evidence for each decision and turning complex findings into clear direction for senior leaders.

Experience researching AI-powered, automation-heavy, CRM, marketing technology, platform or SMB software experiences is highly valuable. Experience using AI-powered tools for synthesis, analysis, documentation or workflow acceleration is expected.

What You'll Do

  • Align Product, Design, Engineering, Data and Product Marketing leaders on a shared research agenda so teams invest in the highest-impact questions instead of running competing studies

  • Connect customer evidence across research, product analytics, Product Marketing and customer-facing teams into one shared view of customer needs and opportunities

  • Lead foundational research, including segmentation, jobs-to-be-done, customer journeys and agency and SMB operating models, that informs company and portfolio strategy

  • Build and run Voice of the Customer programs that synthesize NPS, CSAT, support themes, sales feedback, customer councils and behavioral data into recurring, decision-ready insight

  • Personally lead high-stakes, mixed-methods studies from problem framing through synthesis, recommendation and follow-through

  • Scale research across teams by training designers and product managers, providing guardrails, templates and study reviews, and keeping democratized research rigorous

  • Coach and develop the researchers on your team, setting clear expectations for craft, influence and impact

  • Keep HighLevel executives informed through regular, concise readouts on customer insight, emerging risks and opportunities

  • Track insights through to roadmap decisions and shipped changes, and report the impact research has on product and business outcomes

  • Use AI-powered tools thoughtfully to accelerate synthesis and analysis while protecting research quality, privacy and customer trust

  • Collaborate effectively across US and India time zones in a 100% remote environment

  • Build and scale a high-performing UX Research team, owning talent capability, leadership pipeline, team structure, performance and career development standards, and resource allocation to meet evolving product and business priorities

What We Are Looking For

  • 12+ years of relevant UX research, product research or mixed-methods research experience, including 5+ years leading researchers or research programs

  • Proven experience leading research in complex B2B SaaS, platform or multi-product environments

  • A strong body of work that demonstrates research strategy, methodological judgment, clear synthesis and measurable influence on product and business outcomes

  • Expert command of qualitative and quantitative methods, including interviews, field research, usability testing, survey design, segmentation, concept testing and longitudinal research

  • Demonstrated experience leading foundational research that changed product roadmaps or company strategy, not only feature-level decisions

  • Experience building Voice of the Customer programs and enabling non-researchers to conduct sound research through training, standards and review

  • Strong understanding of research design, sampling, statistical concepts and the tradeoffs behind different levels of research confidence

  • Proven ability to align Product, Design, Engineering, Data, Product Marketing and executive leaders around shared customer evidence

  • Excellent executive communication, with experience briefing senior executives clearly and concisely

  • Fluency with modern research tools such as UserTesting, Dovetail or similar platforms, along with AI-assisted analysis and synthesis workflows

How You Work

  • You bring rigor to ambiguity without slowing teams down unnecessarily

  • You know when more research is needed and when the team has enough evidence to move forward

  • You create outsized impact from a small team by choosing the right problems and multiplying the research capability of others

  • You move comfortably between company strategy, customer insight, business outcomes and hands-on research execution

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability, direct feedback and respect for your teammates as people

  • You enjoy collaborating across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion, ethical research and AI experiences that remain aligned with customer goals

title: Client Partner, Ads Solutions - Financial Services
description:

OpenAI’s Sales team partners with advertisers to understand their businesses, develop meaningful advertising solutions, and drive long-term growth on the platform while maintaining strong standards for user trust and platform integrity.

About the Role
This role will focus on growing advertising revenue across the Financial Services vertical, including banks, credit card issuers, insurance providers, investment and wealth management firms, lending platforms, fintech companies, and adjacent financial services brands.
You will own the full sales cycle—from prospecting through deal closure—and build strategic relationships with senior financial services decision-makers. You will work closely with Account Managers and cross-functional partners to ensure successful advertiser outcomes after the sale, while maintaining primary ownership of revenue growth, commercial strategy, and Financial Services vertical expertise.

In this role, you will:

  • Prospect, qualify, and close new advertising opportunities across the Financial Services vertical.

  • Own and achieve a defined revenue target across an assigned portfolio of financial services advertisers.

  • Build relationships with senior advertising, marketing, digital acquisition, product, and business leaders.

  • Develop account plans that connect advertiser goals—such as account openings, credit card applications, insurance quotes, qualified leads, app adoption, and customer retention—to measurable campaign outcomes.

  • Identify opportunities across major financial services moments, including product launches, tax season, annual enrollment periods, and shifts in consumer financial needs.

  • Structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements.

  • Build clear, data-driven business cases that demonstrate advertiser ROI and long-term platform value.

  • Partner with Account Managers to support seamless post-sale transitions, campaign success, renewals, and expansion.

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Policy, and Operations to support complex deals and inform future advertising solutions.

  • Partner with advertisers and internal teams to navigate industry-specific advertising, privacy, and compliance requirements.

  • Maintain strong pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and a deep understanding of Financial Services industry trends.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 10+ years of experience in digital advertising, performance marketing, client strategy, consulting, or enterprise sales.

  • Have experience working with Financial Services advertisers, such as banks, credit card issuers, insurance providers, investment and wealth management firms, lending platforms, or fintech companies.

  • Have 3+ years of experience advising and influencing senior executives and client stakeholders.

  • Have a proven track record of owning revenue targets and closing complex advertising or commercial deals.

  • Understand financial services customer journeys, acquisition funnels, customer lifetime value, and performance metrics.

  • Have experience navigating the advertising, privacy, and compliance considerations of a regulated industry.

  • Can create compelling business cases and translate advertiser objectives into measurable partnership strategies.

title: Prototype Researcher
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

*Open to hiring remote across the US — we also have offices in New York, San Francisco, and Seattle.

We are looking for a Prototype Researcher to join Runway Labs — our research and exploration team pushing the frontier of AI video and General World Models. You’ll imagine, design, and build experimental experiences that make emerging AI capabilities tangible and communicate a compelling vision for where the technology is heading.

This role combines creative thinking, hands-on prototyping, and storytelling. You should be able to develop an original idea, build a working prototype, and shape it into a clear, memorable demonstration. Your work will help people understand new AI systems through experiences they can see, use, and engage with.

Working closely with researchers, engineers, and designers, you’ll explore new interfaces and interaction paradigms for AI-generated video, world models, and agentic systems. The focus is on research explorations that express our vision, reveal new possibilities, and strengthen Runway’s position as a full-stack research organization.

We’re looking for a motivated self-starter with strong creative judgment, technical fluency, and a portfolio that shows both what you can build and how well you can communicate an idea.

What you’ll do

  • Develop original concepts that explore the possibilities of emerging AI systems, from interactive video and world models to agentic experiences.

  • Design and build working prototypes that turn research capabilities into engaging, understandable experiences.

  • Shape each project’s story: what it explores, why it matters, and what it suggests about the future.

  • Package explorations into polished demos, films, and interactive experiences that communicate our research and vision.

  • Collaborate with researchers and engineers to understand new capabilities and identify compelling ways to demonstrate them.

  • Move quickly through experimentation, using prototypes to test ideas and refine both the experience and its narrative.

What you’ll need

  • A portfolio of original projects that demonstrates creative thinking, design craft, technical execution, and strong storytelling.

  • The ability to take an idea from an early concept to a working prototype and a compelling presentation.

  • Hands-on experience building interactive experiences with code, with the judgment to choose the right tools for each experiment.

  • Strong visual and interaction design skills, with an eye for detail and an instinct for making complex ideas accessible.

  • Genuine curiosity about AI video, world models, agentic systems, and emerging generative media.

  • Comfort working in ambiguous research environments, defining your own direction, and learning new tools as the work evolves.

  • The ability to explain the purpose and potential of your work clearly, through writing, visuals, demos, or film.

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

title: Product Designer, Growth
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Growth at Anthropic is about helping people discover what Claude can do and make it part of how they work, from someone's first session to an entire company rolling out Claude. We're a small design team working across all of Anthropic's products, on problems that often don't have established playbooks, because the products and the capabilities behind them change so quickly.

We drive growth by making the product itself better, favoring foundational changes and new product experiences over small optimizations. Our focus spans whatever most limits Anthropic's growth, and priorities can shift quickly.

As a senior Product Designer on Growth, you'll own how Claude grows with people who use it for their everyday work. You'll dig into why some people make Claude a habit and others don't, find the real bottlenecks, and lead the product changes that move them. You form a clear point of view from messy signals, prototype quickly to test it, and drive alignment across teams to ship it. You use tools like Claude Code to explore ideas and push what's possible.

  • Deep growth design experience in activation, onboarding, retention, engagement, or expansion, on a product at meaningful scale
  • Hands-on experience designing, launching, and interpreting experiments, and using them to make product decisions
  • Fluency with product analytics such as funnels, retention, and engagement
  • Proficiency with design, prototyping, and AI tools, such as Figma and Claude Code, and a habit of learning new tools to push what's possible
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience driving alignment across product, engineering, and data science

  • Experience designing enterprise/B2B SaaS, productivity, or collaboration tools

  • Comfort querying data yourself with SQL or a similar tool

description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are looking for a Vendor Admin Lead to own vendor master data for our global Finance Operations team. Reporting to the Director of Global Accounts Payable, you will be the single point of accountability for who our vendors are and get paid: onboarding, bank-detail verification, supporting documentation vetting, data quality and the controls around all of it. Anthropic's vendor base is growing quickly across the US, Europe and Asia-Pacific, and a clean, verified vendor data is what keeps a fast-growing company scale with the necessary controls.

This role is deliberately separate from invoice processing and payments. You will control vendor records and bank details; you will not book invoices or move money. That separation is the point of the role, and you will own the SOX controls that enforce it and help design the access model that keeps it that way.

This is an opportunity to build a vendor-master function from the ground up and leverage process automation with Claude while supporting the team making AI safe.

  • Run intake for every new vendor and payee: validate completeness, collect and verify supporting documentation, and enable records in the ERP backbone system against agreed service levels

  • Validate supporting documents; set 1099-reportable and tax flags correctly

  • Set up one-time and non-vendor payees with the right record type rather than forcing them through full onboarding

  • Partner with TPRM and IA teams on control requirements and continuous process improvement

  • Validate international bank formats and addresses (IBAN, SWIFT/BIC, ABA, SEPA, BSB, IFSC, Japanese bank/branch codes)

  • Identify and escalate business-email-compromise attempts and other payment-fraud red flags

  • Maintain vendor structure: parent/child and remit-to relationships, entity and country records, contacts and payment terms

  • Lead vendor consolidation: eliminate duplicate vendors and bank accounts, execute merges and inactivations in batched, logged, reviewed changes

  • Run periodic health reviews for dormant vendors, stale bank letters, missing tax forms and incomplete records; drive 1099 and TIN readiness for year-end

  • Own periodic vendor deactivation campaigns

  • Own the vendor-master SOX controls as the named control owner: maker-checker on every create and change, change-log review, evidence retained on every record

  • Prepare the periodic review of bank-detail changes paid, and address Internal Audit and external auditor requests

  • Partner with Finance Systems to design and maintain ERP security roles so vendor master, invoicing and payments stay separated

  • Flag any suspicious vendor set-up activity through the appropriate channels

Process, systems and improvement

  • Own vendor-master documentation, intake checklists, requester guidance and service levels

  • Serve as the vendor-data expert through process migrations, including data conversion and post-migration fixes

  • Partner on automation: AI-assisted intake validation, document extraction, bank-format checks and a vendor self-service portal

  • Report monthly on onboarding volume, cycle time, bank changes, exceptions and data quality, and use the data to improve the process

  • 7+ years in vendor master or AP operations with 3+ years of ownership

  • Owned a vendor master in an ERP end to end — process, controls and data — across multiple entities and countries

  • Hands-on experience verifying bank details and preventing payment fraud: bank letters, independent callbacks, BEC red flags, international bank formats

  • Experience with vendor tax documentation: W-9/W-8 validation, TIN matching, VAT/GST IDs, 1099 flagging

  • Working knowledge of procure-to-pay controls — segregation of duties, maker-checker, change logs, audit evidence — and have performed or owned a SOX control

  • Led a vendor data cleanup, consolidation or ERP migration and can show the outcome

  • The confidence to hold the line with requesters, vendors and senior stakeholders under time pressure while staying clear and helpful

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills with large datasets (dedupe, lookups, reconciliations) and exceptional attention to detail

title: Technical Accounting Lead, Ads Revenue
description:
About the Team

OpenAI Finance ensures the organization is positioned for long-term success as we pursue our mission. The Revenue team plays a critical role in enabling OpenAI to scale commercial offerings by overseeing billing operations, deal desk, revenue systems, revenue accounting, and controllership. We work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Go-To-Market, Tax, Legal, and Technical Accounting to support new monetization strategies, improve operational efficiency, and maintain financial integrity as the business grows.

About the Role

This senior leader will own key elements of Ads revenue accounting from technical assessment through operational execution. The role will guide accounting for products, pricing, contracts, incentives, credits, refunds, makegoods, international expansion, and new go-to-market motions. It will establish governance and translate approved accounting positions into launch, billing, data, close, reconciliation, and control requirements. Success requires deep technical revenue expertise, strong business partnership, and the ability to build durable 0-to-1 processes in a fast-changing environment.

Advertising is a critical and growing monetization vector for OpenAI, and this role will help shape the financial foundations that enable Ads to scale responsibly and transparently.

This role can be based in San Francisco or New York City. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead technical accounting assessments for Ads products and commercial arrangements, including performance obligations, variable consideration, allocation, principal-versus-agent, collectibility, contract modifications, refunds, incentives, credits, makegoods, and revenue presentation.

  • Own and continuously evolve Ads revenue accounting policies and operating guidance as product behavior, pricing, contracting, incentive programs, and billing models change.

  • Establish governance for new products and accounting decisions, including intake, decision rights, materiality and escalation thresholds, launch approvals, policy versioning, decision logs, and post-launch monitoring.

  • Translate accounting conclusions into clear requirements for product design, contracting, billing, data, estimates, close, reconciliations, controls, and reporting.

  • Own the operating cadence for incentive and makegood accounting, invoice readiness, accruals and reserves, settlements, reconciliations, GL tie-outs, flux analysis, reporting, and control evidence.

  • Partner with Ads Product, Engineering, Data, Finance Engineering, Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, Tax, Billing, and Technical Accounting on launches, enterprise negotiations, and international expansion.

  • Prepare concise technical memos and audit-ready support; align novel or material conclusions with Corporate Technical Accounting and external auditors.

  • Use data, AI, and automation to improve research, monitoring, policy maintenance, issue tracking, documentation, and repeatable Finance workflows with appropriate review controls.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in revenue accounting, including direct ownership of complex ASC 606 judgments and operational execution.

  • Demonstrated leadership to independently set direction, prioritize across competing risks, and influence senior cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Experience with digital advertising, adtech, marketplaces, payments, usage-based services, or another high-volume transaction environment.

  • Strong command of variable consideration, principal-versus-agent, contract modifications, incentives and credits, collectibility, estimates, and revenue presentation.

  • Track record building 0-to-1 accounting processes, governance, close mechanisms, reconciliations, and controls that scale.

  • Ability to turn technical conclusions into practical product, contract, billing, data, and operating requirements.

  • Clear, concise written and executive communication, including audit-ready documentation and evidence-based recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting global launches, multiple currencies, international contracting entities, intercompany considerations, or localized billing models.

  • Experience applying AI or automation within Finance while maintaining review, validation, and control standards.

  • Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data, or Finance systems teams.

  • Experience developing or leading high-performing accounting teams or distributed operating groups.

  • Background in public-company controllership, technical accounting, audit, or similarly rigorous control environments.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

title: Global Initiatives Curator
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Offline Design team shapes what makes an Airbnb Experience worth traveling for. Our Curation team sets and upholds the quality bar for Experiences globally, translating taste into repeatable systems that scale across markets. This role reports to the Director of Experience Design and partners closely with Supply Acquisition, Product Marketing, Market Management, Demand, Growth Marketing, Research, and Enterprise Operations to strategize and bring Experiences to life around the world.

The Difference You Will Make:

As the Global Initiatives Curator, you will lead new, first-of-their-kind initiatives that scale the Curation team's impact in step with the needs of the Experiences business. You will solve complex, cross-functional problems, then brief the Curation team on how to action the solutions globally and at scale. Success looks like a unified quality bar across markets, a clear architecture for the types of Experiences we offer, new markets launched with consistent processes, and AI-enabled tools that make the team's taste repeatable at scale.

A Typical Day:

  • Store design & quality: Maintain the quality bar of sourced Experiences globally, and unify the quality of co-designed Experiences with the Supply Acquisition team across regions.
  • Market launches & experiences strategy: Support new market launches with unified processes, identify supply categories based on demand, store performance, and external signals, and surface strategic differentiation bets across global markets.
  • Experiences architecture & storytelling: Define the architecture and criteria for types of Experiences. Craft the narrative for new supply types to leadership, and cascade it to internal teams.
  • Scale learnings globally: Identify new experiences opportunities to prototype based on regional observations, spot strengths in individual markets, and scale those learnings to others.
  • Build with AI: Partner with Research and Enterprise Operations to build AI tools that unify the Curation team's processes and codify taste at scale.
  • Curate for moments & channels: Partner with Product Marketing to imagine and test future curation possibilities in product. Curate the highest-quality, most differentiated supply into collections for Airbnb launch moments and advise on merchandising to maximize both direct bookings and brand recognition.

Your Expertise:

  • Experience: 12+ years across a mix of product marketing, marketing, creative direction, and experience design at a large-scale or tech company, with 4+ years leading and briefing teams to deliver work.
  • Global & cross-functional leadership: Experience working on a global product and leading a global team, with a strong record of cross-functional collaboration and coordinating across time zones.
  • Taste & cultural fluency: A high level of taste shaped by brands known for it, and the cultural fluency to adapt a brief or strategy to different audiences and markets.
  • Strategic problem solving: Ability to break complex challenges into simple, actionable steps, with a track record of building strategic frameworks and briefs that teams can execute.
  • 0-to-1 leadership: Experience leading 0-to-1 initiatives in a highly cross-functional environment, with comfort navigating ambiguity and adapting to changing strategy in a fast-moving culture.
  • Communication & narrative: Strong verbal and written communication, with experience building presentations that carry ideas from ideation to execution with senior leadership.

title: Procurement Operations Business Partner, Technology
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Procurement Operations is the front door for buying at Anthropic. We sit inside Finance Operations and own the path from “I need to buy something” to a signed agreement, an accurate purchase order, and clean spend data at month end.

We are hiring a Procurement Operations Business Partner to own that path for our technology spend: business applications, SaaS tools, cloud and infrastructure services, and the engineering and developer tools our teams build with. This portfolio is software heavy: new tools evaluated and onboarded regularly, licenses that renew on their own schedule, and vendors billed on seats, usage, or tiered subscription terms rather than a single invoice. You will be the person who makes buying software feel simple to the teams who depend on it and reliable to the Finance stakeholders behind it. This is a high-volume role with an accounting core. You ensure every software purchase in your portfolio is coded, dated, received, and accrued correctly, so spend is right in the books every month. Expect a steady queue of new tool requests, renewals, and license changes, and expect to be the person Accounting trusts on all of it.

We use Claude as part of our daily workflow and are looking for someone who wants to help define what an AI-native procurement operations function looks like, including how AI changes intake, contract and security review, vendor coordination, and requester support.

Responsibilities

Own the purchasing process

  • Manage a high volume of purchase requests, renewals, and license changes each month across the organization, keeping speed and accuracy high at the same time.

  • Serve as the primary procurement partner for the teams buying in your categories, guiding requesters from initial request to signed agreement and issued purchase order.

  • Review every purchase request in your portfolio for the things that matter downstream: the right vendor record and contracting entity, complete commercial documents, correct spend categorization and service dates, and the approvals the purchase actually needs.

  • Determine what else each request requires before it can move, whether that is an order form, a data privacy review, or a third party risk assessment, and route it to the right reviewers the first time.

  • Partner with Security to run a vendor security review on every new tool and at every renewal, and hold the line that nothing goes live without one.

  • Launch and track contract review with Legal, keep it moving, and confirm the executed agreement supports the purchase order before it is issued.

  • Structure purchase orders so they match how the vendor bills (seat-based, usage-based, tiered subscription, or flat annual fee) and how Accounting needs to see the spend, with the right GL account, cost center, and service period on every line. Manage renewals, true ups, and seat count changes over the life of each agreement.

  • Track license counts and renewal dates across your portfolio so nothing auto-renews or lapses by surprise, and flag underused or overlapping tools to budget owners ahead of the next renewal cycle.

Financial completeness and accuracy

  • Code every purchase order correctly at creation, including GL account, spend category, cost center, and service period, and understand how each choice lands in the financials (expense versus prepaid, annual versus monthly recognition).

  • Work the hard cases with Accounting: multi year subscriptions paid upfront, mid term seat additions, true ups, credits, and contracts amended mid cycle.

  • Own the open purchase order book: receipts recorded against actual delivery, periodic reviews, stale line cleanup, coding corrections, and timely closures, so PO, receipt, and invoice agree.

  • Serve as the first line reviewer for month-end accruals on your portfolio, gathering estimates from vendors and budget owners for variable spend and confirming or correcting proposed amounts so Accounting can close on time.

  • Partner with Accounts Payable to resolve invoice holds, PO mismatches, and receiving questions so vendors are paid on time and spend lands where it belongs.

  • Support audit and reporting requests that touch your portfolio, including commitment schedules and control evidence, with data you can stand behind.

Be the front door

  • Be visible and responsive in your teams' Slack channels and office hours; answer routine purchasing questions quickly and escalate real blockers with context.

  • Apply purchasing policy consistently and explain the why, including approval thresholds, signature authority, and when an exception is and is not available.

  • Translate procurement, legal, security, and finance requirements into plain language for engineers, IT, and business stakeholders, and carry their operating reality back to those teams so controls fit the work.

  • Keep a regular check in with your highest volume teams so upcoming purchases and renewals are visible early and nothing urgent arrives as a surprise.

Continuous improvement

  • Maintain the playbooks, intake guidance, and standard operating procedures for your portfolio so the path is repeatable and does not live in one person's head.

  • Identify manual steps, repeat questions, and failure points and fix them, including where Claude and workflow automation with AI can take work off requesters and the team.

Minimum qualifications

  • Proven track record of owning a high-volume purchasing portfolio end-to-end in a procure-to-pay and intake platform.

  • Solid working knowledge of accrual accounting as it applies to purchasing: accruals and reversals, service period and cutoff, prepaid versus expense, and GL and cost center coding. You can explain how a purchase order becomes an entry in the general ledger.

  • Experience buying and managing software or SaaS at scale, including seat-based, usage-based, and tiered subscription billing models.

  • Experience owning the tool and vendor lifecycle end to end, from intake through security review, contracting, renewal, and sunset, with the judgment to know when to push a request through and when to slow it down.

Preferred qualifications

  • 7+ years of procurement operations, purchasing, or vendor operations, including time supporting IT, engineering, or business systems teams.

  • Background in accounting, accounts payable, or a month-end close process.

  • Direct experience with Zip, Workday Financials, and Ironclad.

  • Prior ownership of month-end accrual review or open PO reconciliation for a large, variable spend portfolio.

  • Experience with software asset management or license optimization, including identifying underused or redundant tools.

  • Experience designing tiered intake or approval frameworks that sped up low risk purchases without weakening controls.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$190,000—$230,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Sr. Product Designer
description:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product judgment and strong execution. You have spent 5+ years designing complex digital products and are ready to own meaningful work from early ambiguity through shipped outcomes.

As a senior individual contributor, you will partner closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, data partners and other designers on cross-functional teams that own and improve key product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals and technical constraints to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate exceptional visual and interaction design judgment, practical systems thinking and the ability to carry work from discovery through delivery. You should care deeply about the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent.

Experience designing B2B SaaS, platform, CRM, workflow-heavy or SMB software experiences is highly valuable. Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is expected. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You'll Do

  • Use qualitative and quantitative insight to make design decisions and improve outcomes

  • Collaborate effectively across US and India time zones in a 100% remote environment

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of relevant product design experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, platform, CRM, workflow-heavy or similarly complex digital product environments

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates product judgment, systems thinking, customer empathy, high-quality execution and measurable product impact

  • Proven experience across the design lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content design and usability testing

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality

  • Working knowledge of design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted design workflows, intelligent interfaces, modern design tooling and fast prototyping practices

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, researchers, data partners and other designers

  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions, incorporate feedback and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft

  • Understanding of front-end implementation constraints and the ability to bridge practical gaps between design and code

  • Curiosity about users, data, systems, new tools, emerging technologies and better ways for teams to work

How You Work

  • You move comfortably from customer insight and product strategy to detailed design execution

title: Member of Technical Staff, ML Platform
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

We're looking for an ML infrastructure engineer to own model evaluation at Runway, end to end. Every decision we make about a model – which checkpoint to keep training, what to ship to millions of users, which datamix and architecture shows the most promise – rests on evals. Today that work is spread across the organization. You'll turn it into one platform.

Your job will be to design and build the systems that generate samples at scale, score them with automated metrics and human annotations, track results across checkpoints and releases, and put the answers in front of researchers in minutes rather than days. You'll define what "better" means operationally – how we measure it, how confident we are, and how a result becomes a ship/no-ship decision.

You'll be embedded within research teams as a member of ML Platform, and you'll set the technical direction for evals across the company. This is an extremely high-leverage role: the quality of our models is bounded by how well we can measure them.

A peek at our technical stack

Our inference and training code is written in Python (PyTorch) and is cloud-native. We leverage multiple clouds and use a combination of Kubernetes native and home-grown tooling for efficient job orchestration.

We’re big users of agentic development and operations. We have a robust internal platform and provide broad access to the latest models and harnesses.

You’ll have access to best-in-class models, agents, GPUs, storage and cloud services you need to drive a world class evaluation pipeline that helps us deliver frontier models.

What you'll do

  • Own the evaluation platform end to end: the tooling and systems required to generate, annotate, review and adapt at frontier scale

  • Define the CLIs, APIs, GUIs and storage layers required to make this process seamless, fast, sophisticated and collaborative

  • Work directly with research teams on video, image, audio, agents, and robotics to understand what they need to measure and build it, then generalize the result into the platform

  • Help set the standards for how we evaluate models at Runway: reproducibility, metric definitions, reporting formats, and when a result is trustworthy enough to act on

  • Support broad adoption of the platform and its integration throughout Runway’s research efforts across training, production model serving and more

  • Contribute broadly as a member of the ML Platform team to tools and systems that help Runway train and serve frontier models

What you'll need

  • 5+ years of experience building ML infrastructure or data platforms in production environments, with at least some of that time spent on evaluation, experimentation, or benchmarking systems

  • Strong Python and PyTorch, and hands-on experience running large batch GPU workloads on Kubernetes

  • Experience designing data pipelines and storage for large volumes of media or model outputs, with attention to versioning and reproducibility

  • Familiarity with experimental statistics: paired comparisons, confidence intervals, multiple-comparison pitfalls, inter-rater agreement

  • Comfort building internal tools end to end, from the command line to the browser

  • Ability to lead a broad technical area: gather requirements from many teams, set direction, make tradeoffs, and drive a roadmap without waiting to be told

  • Familiarity with the full model development lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, serving

  • Self-starter who can work embedded with research teams and move fast

  • Strong systems thinking and pragmatic approach to production reliability

  • Humility and open mindedness; at Runway we love to learn from one another

Nice to have

  • Track record of building evaluation suites for generative models

  • Hands-on work with LLM- or VLM-as-judge pipelines

  • Experience with online experimentation platforms and connecting offline metrics to product outcomes

  • Prior work evaluating agents or robotics policies

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

Working at Runway

Great things come from great teams. We’d love to hear from you.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. So regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply.

title: Policy Advocacy - Political Research
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced public opinion researcher to build and expand Anthropic's in-house polling and research function. This role will be fundamental to understanding how key audiences — from policymakers and third-party groups to the general public — perceive and respond to Anthropic's policy positions, messages, and campaigns. This is a foundational role: you'll establish the research function from the ground up, with high autonomy and limited precedent.

The Central Policy team sits at the operational heart of Anthropic's policy function — distinct from government relations and communications, but essential to enabling both. You'll work cross-functionally to ensure our policy and communications strategy is grounded in a rigorous understanding of stakeholder sentiment. The polling insights you generate will directly feed into high-visibility campaigns and will be a key asset in our policy efforts in Washington and beyond.

Anthropic is equal parts research lab, policy think-tank, and technology startup. We care deeply about the safe development of AI systems and build partnerships with governments through proactive, opinionated, substantive policy conversations. This role offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of AI policy, bringing rigorous research discipline to policy strategy.

Success in this role means establishing trusted relationships with leading polling firms around the world, delivering high-quality research on a regular cadence, and becoming the internal expert on how key audiences perceive AI, Anthropic, and Anthropic's positions and messages. You'll translate polling insights into strategic recommendations that measurably improve campaign effectiveness, and build scalable processes that allow the function to grow efficiently as demand increases.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop a comprehensive strategy for our in-house political research function that aligns with Anthropic's policy goals

  • Identify, evaluate, and establish relationships with leading research and polling firms, ensuring coverage across demographics, geographies, and political perspectives

  • Conduct detailed, proactive research to test core messages, policy proposals, and campaign themes, and to evaluate Anthropic's brand perception and performance

  • Execute rapid-response polling to quickly assess Anthropic's messaging strategy in response to external events, policymaker actions, competitive developments, or emerging opportunities

  • Work with external affairs colleagues (federal, state, and international) and policy communications to identify research priorities, interpret findings, and translate insights into actionable strategic recommendations

  • Develop and maintain a knowledge management system for polling data, insights, and recommendations that ensures findings are accessible and actionable

  • Manage polling vendors at scale, including vendor performance management

  • Participate in strategy sessions and provide thought partnership on the design of messages, policy proposals, and campaigns ahead of polling and testing

  • Create clear, compelling deliverables that distill polling findings into insights and recommendations

  • Ability to analyze quantitative and qualitative polling data and translate findings into clear, decision-ready written recommendations

  • Experience selecting, briefing, and managing external polling or research vendors

  • Strong writing and presentation skills, including distilling complex research for senior, non-technical audiences

Preferred qualifications

  • Corporate public affairs experience, ideally in a highly scrutinized or regulated industry

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. description:

Our design charter is to help foster an emotional connection with our community, keeping usability and accessibility as our prime virtues. We do our best to practice inclusive design at every turn, spanning across online and offline experiences we create for our Host and Guest communities.

As a Staff Experience Designer, you will play a critical role in shaping how Airbnb shows up in markets across APAC and globally. Sitting at the intersection of product, design, and regional strategy, you will work across time zones and functions to define and deliver an international roadmap that spans both tactical UI improvements and larger strategic bets. You will bring a high bar for visual and interaction design craft, model AI-enabled ways of working, and provide design leadership in a space that is growing in complexity and impact for Airbnb globally. The Staff Experience Designer is an individual contributor (IC) role that will report to a Manager or Director of Experience Design.
